# awscc_apiportal_organization_discovery_configuration (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::OrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration. Organization-wide singleton that configures API discovery across an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `discovery_sources` (Set of String) The AWS services whose resources are scanned to discover APIs.

### Optional

- `discovery_features` (Set of String) Optional discovery capabilities to enable.
- `discovery_filters` (Attributes) Scopes organization-wide discovery. Exactly one of ExclusionFilters or InclusionFilters is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_filters))
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the organization discovery configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the organization discovery configuration.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the organization discovery configuration was created.
- `discovery_configuration_status` (String) The status of the organization discovery configuration.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the organization discovery configuration was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_filters`

Optional:

- `exclusion_filters` (Attributes) Resources matching any of these filters are excluded from discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_filters--exclusion_filters))
- `inclusion_filters` (Attributes) Only resources matching any of these filters are included in discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_filters--inclusion_filters))

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_filters--exclusion_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_filters.exclusion_filters`

Optional:

- `account_ids` (Set of String) AWS account IDs to exclude from discovery.
- `organizational_unit_ids` (Set of String) Organizational unit IDs to exclude from discovery.
- `resource_arns` (Set of String) Resource ARNs to exclude from discovery.


<a id="nestedatt--discovery_filters--inclusion_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_filters.inclusion_filters`

Optional:

- `account_ids` (Set of String) AWS account IDs to include in discovery.
- `organizational_unit_ids` (Set of String) Organizational unit IDs to include in discovery.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_organization_discovery_configuration.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```
